blocks.text: Programming consists of describing, through instructions, a sequence of operations that a computer can execute. Before writing code, there is usually a problem we want to solve and a logical sequence of steps for solving it.
A C++ program can contain instructions that produce visible results, perform calculations, store information, or control other system components.
This example displays a message in the program output. Later, we will study each part separately.

blocks.question: Which statement best describes programming?
options: Memorizing the instructions of a programming language.
Expressing a solution through instructions that a computer can execute.
blocks.explanation: Programming involves creating instructions that represent a solution. Syntax is the tool used to express it.

blocks.text: A compiler transforms the source code you write into a form that can be executed. In this application, we will use a real C++ compiler to test our programs and observe both their output and the errors detected during compilation.
Modify the program, write instructions inside main, and tap Compile and Run. If there is an error, the compiler will indicate the line and column where it was detected.
